name: StartInfo
description: Parameters controlling how jobs are started

ReleaseKey.description: GUID key of the process (release) to start

Strategy.description: Strategy for allocating robots to the job

RobotIds.description: List of robot IDs to use when Strategy is RobotIds or Specific

NoOfRobots.description: Number of robots to use when Strategy is JobsCount

Source.description: Source attribution for the started jobs

InputArguments.description: JSON-serialized input arguments to pass to the process

JobPriority.description: Priority level for the job queue
